framework: NVIDIA NeMo / Megatron-Bridge recipe of the MLPerf Training v6.1 release 20261012, unmodified, on NVIDIA NGC PyTorch 26.09
implementation_source: NVIDIA llama31_8b reference implementation (MLPerf Training v6.1, 20261012), code, Dockerfile and config unchanged; see README.md in implementations/nemo_l1_1012

container.base_image: nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.09-py3 (the Dockerfile's FROM_IMAGE_NAME default; pinned for a rebuild as nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.09-py3@sha256:6e8ccc607fc2a51e3741667b86316a0889418ba8b78ed0ba96e8d282b648a7a6)
container.build_args: setup.sh in this directory passes FROM_IMAGE_NAME (the pinned base), MBRIDGE_REVISION=ea5dded83078cf7e61ef91960273053cf564d5ac and TE_REVISION=5b28d7aa2bd639ff0541356cc025f62954f96ce3 (the commits the image that ran recorded), and fails after the build unless /TE_COMMIT_HASH.env, /MBRIDGE_COMMIT_HASH.env, /MCORE_COMMIT_HASH.env and the direct_url.json commits of mlperf-logging and mlperf-common equal the image that ran
container.image_that_ran: NVIDIA's build of this Dockerfile, squashfs sha256 97a310af019f1006d9aa60196ce81122795852d26ba979d80bbe411e0b8e0c2b, 26031730688 bytes
container.public_rebuild: not run (open by decision); the image's recipe directory and commit records were read from the squashfs (README.md, The image that produced the results)

config_file: config_GB300_2x4x2xtp1pp1cp1_8b_fp4.sh (NVIDIA's GB300 2-node config from the 20261012 image, unchanged)

precision.communication: logged nvfp4 (NVIDIA's config_common_fp4.sh); actual bfloat16: BF16 parameter all-gather and gradient reduce-scatter (README.md, Logged precision)

launcher: implementations/nemo_l1_1012/run.sub (differences from NVIDIA's run.sub: run.sub.vs_nvidia1012.diff in this directory)
result_logs: results/firmus_gb300_ngpu8_llama8b_l1_1012/llama31_8b/result_0..9.txt: the raw logs after redact_logs.sh in this directory (internal storage paths redacted on non-MLLOG lines; MLLOG lines unchanged)
